answer: Designing a mechanism where truthful reporting remains a strict equilibrium requires a costly signaling constraint that renders mass sybil creation economically unviable. An attacker attempting to flood the network faces a steep bond requirement entangled with the vine of cascading slashing rules that destroys collateral upon detected collusion. Extracting net value becomes impossible when submitting false agent profiles triggers penalties exceeding any potential subsidy, though this juniper threshold inevitably sacrifices marginal inclusion of liquidity-constrained honest agents.
